name: Deister
source:
Half-man, half-Segitt, he is big and also intelligent. After amassing a huge fortune, he bought a debt-ridden hotel and turned it into "Deister Hotel", a ultra-luxury hotel.

[spoiler] In reality, he is a serial rapist and murderer who raped and killed at least ten young women. He has a younger twinbrother, who has the ability of time rewind to help him achieve success as well as get away with murder. [/spoiler]
